{{Quote|Yeah, well, it's always crowded around Iphigin. Main transfer point for this sector and at least two others.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], to [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]|<ref name="SotP" />}}
The '''Iphigin system''' was located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Galactic Core]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iphigin]], home to the [[Iphigini]].
